fusions.name: Silt Bank
fusions.desc: Raises a slow wall of water 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Seep
fusions.desc: Spits a clot of silt that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Over

riders.text: you drift across it faster than ground

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you cross it 15% faster than ground.
